notes: two routes: the first ends at Abu Hurayra with «نحوه» (the same saying as before), the second («حدثنا بذلك عبيد») gives the same hadith («بهذا الحديث») after it
«قال حدثت عن أبي صالح» is passive: the source of Al-A'mash is not named, so the link is unnamed
«وكأن هذا أصح من الحديث الأول» is the compiler's remark, left out
«حدثني أبي» names the father only by relation
